mapper.sql: a.ASSESSMENT_ID AS assessmentId, a.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, a.ASSESSED_AT AS assessedAt, a.INPUT_BASE_MONTH AS inputBaseMonth, a.WORKER_TYPE_CODE AS workerTypeCode, a.GRADE_STATUS_CODE AS gradeStatusCode, a.NOT_SCORABLE_REASON_CODE AS notScorableReasonCode, a.MODEL_VERSION AS modelVersion, a.CUTOFF_VERSION AS cutoffVersion, a.TRAD_SCORABLE_YN AS tradScorableYn, a.TRAD_SCORE AS tradScore, a.TRAD_GRADE_BAND_CODE AS tradGradeBandCode, a.TRAD_DEFAULT_PROB AS tradDefaultProb, a.ALT_SCORABLE_YN AS altScorableYn, a.ALT_SCORE AS altScore, a.ALT_GRADE_BAND_CODE AS altGradeBandCode, a.ALT_DEFAULT_PROB AS altDefaultProb, a.SHAP_BASE_SCORE AS shapBaseScore, a.AI_SUMMARY AS aiSummary
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ASSESSMENT a WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.DATASET_CODE = 'SERVICE' ORDER BY a.ASSESSED_AT DESC, a.ASSESSMENT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT FROM ASSESSMENT a WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.DATASET_CODE = 'SERVICE' AND a.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}

SELECT b.GRADE_BAND_CODE AS gradeBandCode, b.MIN_SCORE AS minScore, b.MAX_SCORE AS maxScore FROM ASSESSMENT a JOIN SCORE_GRADE_BAND b ON b.CUTOFF_VERSION = a.CUTOFF_VERSION WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.DATASET_CODE = 'SERVICE' AND a.ASSESSMENT_ID = #{assessmentId} ORDER BY b.MIN_SCORE ASC

SELECT f.FEATURE_RANK AS rank, f.FEATURE_CODE AS featureCode, d.FEATURE_NAME AS featureName, d.UNIT_NAME AS unitName, f.FEATURE_VALUE AS featureValue, f.SHAP_SCORE AS shapScore, d.ALTERNATIVE_YN AS alternativeYn, d.SIMULATABLE_YN AS simulatableYn FROM ASSESSMENT a JOIN ASSESSMENT_FACTOR f ON f.ASSESSMENT_ID = a.ASSESSMENT_ID AND f.FEATURE_SET_VERSION = a.FEATURE_SET_VERSION JOIN DIM_FEATURE d ON d.FEATURE_SET_VERSION = f.FEATURE_SET_VERSION AND d.FEATURE_CODE = f.FEATURE_CODE WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.DATASET_CODE = 'SERVICE' AND a.ASSESSMENT_ID = #{assessmentId} ORDER BY f.FEATURE_RANK ASC
